records.name: Zeleni Venac market toilet
records.description_rewritten: The underground public toilets at Belgrade's Zeleni Venac market/bus interchange have matching records in the original directory and Squirt. The original source places them below the market beside parking, while the Squirt entry describes a Kamenicka-side approach. March 2026 comments include direct claims of activity and a conflicting complaint that entry costs money or the wrong toilet is being used.
records.identity_and_location: Zeleni Venac market, Zeleni venac 2, Belgrade; source describes toilets below market, but city also manages a Zeleni Venac bus-terminus WC nearby, possibly a DIFFERENT building.
records.access_conditions: Official market operator: open market 06:00–19:00, adjacent garage 06:00–21:00; municipal operator says bus-terminus WC free and open winter 07:00–22:30, summer 07:00–23:00. Squirt's older '9 to 5' may refer to different market toilet; do not substitute hours without exact WC match.

A May 2026 online comment explicitly says nothing was happening at that time.

records.name: Public toilet at Vracar

Two dated comments from 2023 and January 2025 describe the location as empty during their visits.
